summary: Tested 8 new features for Habari Stays. All features are working correctly: Search state persistence, Back arrows on Hotel Detail/Booking Flow/Admin Performance modal, Verified badges logic, Login modal gating for phone numbers, Starting price display (Kuanzia), Dynamic city dropdown without Zanzibar, Popular Cities section, and Cashier mobile-first dashboard.

issues: Text mentions 'Zanzibar' in the subtitle ('Hoteli bora Tanzania - Dodoma, Dar, Arusha, Zanzibar') - should be removed to match city dropdown exclusion
React hydration warnings about '<span> cannot be a child of <select>' - cosmetic warning from dynamic content wrapper, doesn't affect functionality

passed_tests: FEATURE 1: Search state persistence - City filter 'Musoma' preserved after navigating to hotel detail and back
FEATURE 2: Back arrow on Hotel Detail page - data-testid='back-to-search' found and working
FEATURE 2b: Back arrow on Booking Flow - data-testid='booking-back-btn' with ChevronLeft icon found, shows 'Rudi' text
FEATURE 2c: Admin Performance modal back arrow - data-testid='perf-back-btn' found, modal closes on click
FEATURE 3: Verified badges on hotel cards - Correctly shows 'Wasiliana Moja kwa Moja' (Contact Directly) for imported hotels, no verified badges (expected since all hotels are imported status)
FEATURE 3b: Verified badge on hotel detail - No badge shown for imported hotels (correct behavior)
FEATURE 4: Login modal gating for phone - data-testid='gated-call-btn' triggers data-testid='detail-login-modal' for unauthenticated users
FEATURE 5: Starting price on hotel cards - 'Kuanzia' only shows for non-imported hotels (correct behavior per design)
FEATURE 5b: Starting price on hotel detail - 'Kuanzia TZS 50,000' shown in hero section for all hotels with min_price
FEATURE 6: Dynamic city dropdown - Cities from API (Dodoma, Kambarage Area, Musoma, Mwanza, Shinyanga), Zanzibar correctly excluded
FEATURE 7: Popular Cities section - Cities (Dodoma, Mwanza, Musoma) displayed on homepage, Zanzibar not in cities section
FEATURE 8: Cashier mobile-first dashboard - data-testid='cashier-sidebar' for desktop, data-testid='mobile-tab-bar' for mobile viewport
action_items: MINOR: Update homepage hero subtitle to remove 'Zanzibar' from the text ('Hoteli bora Tanzania - Dodoma, Dar, Arusha, Zanzibar')
critical_code_review_comments: Feature 5 clarification: 'Kuanzia' pricing on hotel cards only appears for verified/owner_attached hotels (not imported). This is intentional - imported hotels show Contact Directly label instead. Since all current hotels are imported status, Kuanzia won't appear on search cards.
Feature 3 clarification: Verified badges only show for hotels with status='verified' or 'owner_attached'. All current hotels are 'imported' so badges correctly don't appear.
